title: Skill Function Settings

fields.label: HubSpot Form ID
fields.name: hubspot_form_id
fields.instructions: HubSpot form ID for gating videos on this function's page. This will be used for all skills in this function unless a skill has its own form ID specified. Example: 097ee201-0440-4b59-a68e-d682966a8e08

fields.label: Related Skill Functions
fields.name: related_skill_functions
fields.instructions: Select up to 3 related skill functions that will appear on this function's detail page. These are displayed above the Resources section.

description: Settings for individual Skill Function taxonomy terms including related functions
